title: Amplified Vulnerabilities: Structured Jailbreak Attacks on LLM-based Multi-Agent Debate
reasoning: The paper evaluates the security vulnerabilities of Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) systems through jailbreak attacks. Although it measures the 'harmfulness' of model responses using safety policies (e.g., assessing content for illegal acts or hate), this is done as a metric for attack success and system robustness rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
